channel.title: Voice of Startup Bangladesh
channel.description: Verified Bangladesh startup, business and investment news

item.title: Eco-Friendly E-Bike Rental Service 'Ezigo' in Cox's Bazar: A Story of New Freedom for Tourists
item.description: Cox's Bazar is one of the main tourist centers of Bangladesh. Millions of people flock here every year, especially to enjoy the beauty of the longest beach and the scenic Marine Drive.

item.title: Rooftop gardening started as a hobby, now selling trees worth 2 lakh rupees a month
item.description: The range includes purple delight, murasaki, hakuho, crassula, jade plant and other varieties of plants. The price of each tree is 100 to 30 thousand taka. For commercial tree production, he rented a roof for five thousand rupees a month.

item.title: Startups will get loans of up to 8 crore rupees, funds of 1200 crore rupees
item.description: If any of the entrepreneurs default, they or their organization will not be eligible for the loan. Any venture formed by restructuring or demerger of an earlier business shall not be considered as a startup.

item.title: The annual income of Hello Tasks by providing domestic workers is now Rs 1 crore
item.description: The journey of a startup starts from the thought of getting down from a seven-story building and buying something. Initially, this startup was to deliver various types of household products or provide family assistant services.

item.title: Two entrepreneurs earn crores of rupees a year by making games
item.description: As of 2020, Naptech Labs, the company of these two entrepreneurs, has developed and published more than 600 games so far. These games have been played more than 2 crore times online so far.

item.title: Bangladesh's Path and Possible among Asia's top 100 startups, Forbes list released
item.description: Two companies from Bangladesh have been ranked among the top 100 startup companies in the Asia-Pacific region. Ride-sharing companies can also be found on the list, which can be helpful in sending and finding jobs.

item.title: The story of Saiful, a successful entrepreneur who left his traditional job and became an agriculturist
item.description: Starting from the soil of Faridpur, 'Bismillah Agro' is now a well-known and reliable agricultural brand in the country. Saiful Islam Saif chose agriculture instead of chasing traditional jobs.

item.title: Disbursement of loans from startup funds of thousands of crores of rupees is only 35 crores
item.description: Bangladesh Bank formed two funds in March 2021 for the startup sector. After that, more than 1000 crore rupees were accumulated in the fund in three years. However, till now 35 crore 20 lakh taka has been distributed among the startup companies.

item.title: Started business with 9 thousand taka, now annual sales are 12 crores
item.description: Intro – Sajid Khan, the entrepreneur of Skyflora Limited, has won the best entrepreneur in the agriculture category at IDLC-Pratham Alo SME Award-2023. In the beginning of 2015, their annual sales were 50 thousand to 1 lakh taka. Now they are selling products and services worth 10-12 crore rupees.

item.title: Loan transfer facility at BRAC Bank at 9 percent interest, no additional cost
item.description: BRAC Bank has announced the purchase (takeover) of personal loans (personal loans) and housing loans (home loans) in any bank or financial institution at low interest. Under this special offer, customers will have to pay 9 percent interest in the first year.

item.title: Started with 300 taka, now his business is worth thousands of taka
item.description: He started the vegetable business in 1977 with a capital of only 300 rupees. From that business today his business size is about 1000 crore rupees. This successful candidate is Md. Phultala of Khulna. Feroze Ahmed.

item.title: Starting with 30 thousand, RK Hannan's business is now worth half a crore
item.description: RK Hannan used to sell various leather products on an e-commerce website in addition to his studies while his classmates were busy studying in the university.

item.title: Voice of Startup Bangladesh: A New Horizon for Business Expansion and Funding
item.description: Bangladesh is an emerging economic superpower in the world today. One of the biggest driving forces behind this progress has been the innovative ventures or 'startups' of young and daring entrepreneurs.

item.title: Global communication platform 'Jatt Messenger' built on indigenous technology
item.description: The new browser-based communication platform 'JAT Messenger' has been developed as a completely indigenous initiative to connect the people of the world across the distance barrier.

item.title: 30 lakhs start, profit 2.5 crores in three years
item.description: During the coronavirus pandemic, customers had to face various difficulties in getting products through online and e-commerce platforms.

item.title: 'Arogya' of health care, big success in five years
item.description: Seeking medical care when sick in the country is a challenging issue for many. One has to wait for a long time to get the serial to consult the doctor.

item.title: Started with 600 taka, now the business is crores of taka
item.description: In 2017, he started his business by selling mangoes online. Mahmudunnabi Sohag. This young man from Baraigram upazila of Natore now sells more than three hundred agricultural products worth about crores of taka per month.

item.title: Watching YouTube, dragon farming on the roof, annual income of lakhs of rupees
item.description: After learning from YouTube, in 2024, he planted dragon fruit on the roof garden of the house, yard and land on lease. Abu Hanif (62). He is now earning lakhs of rupees a year by selling dragons to meet the needs of his family.

item.title: Abu Manzoor Saif is a successful entrepreneur who left the government job
item.description: Entrepreneur Abu Manzoor Saif is processing Pangas fish to make 'Bacha Fille' (boneless fish meat). He supplies this fillet of fish to various hotels and restaurants in the country, along with business and educational institutions. It is getting huge response.

item.title: Successful startup 'Crack Platoon' in charging station initiative
item.description: The use of electric vehicles is increasing rapidly in the developed countries of the world. Compared to that, the demand for electric vehicles in the country is increasing slowly. Industry stakeholders say that high prices and lack of charging infrastructure are the major reasons for the low interes

item.title: Hundreds of millionaires in one union by farming fish
item.description: Recently, Muhuri river area of ​​Osmanpur Union, West Banshkhali and Patakot can be seen, fish farms have been developed in a wide area. Somewhere the workers are feeding the fish in the farm, somewhere the preparation for fishing is going on.

item.title: Bangladesh's own search engine 'Doel' has started its journey
item.description: Another new feather has been added to the technology sector of Bangladesh through the 'Doel' search engine. Built entirely on indigenous technology, this platform brings modern search facilities to global users.

item.title: Jute export to 30 countries from tin business
item.description: A jute mill inspired by mother is making world class hydro-carbon free bags. Annual income is more than Tk 200 crore in foreign exchange. The rural economy of North Bengal is booming.

item.title: Grameenphone did a business of Tk 11,756 crore in 9 months
item.description: The profit of Grameenphone (GP), the top company in the country's telecom sector, has decreased by Tk 92 crore. In the first 9 months of this year (January-September), the company has made a profit of 2 thousand 172 crores.

item.title: Starting with 10 duck eggs, Bibi Rahima now owns a 16 acre farm
item.description: Bibi Rahima collected 10 duck eggs from a neighbor and placed them under the native chicken in her house for hatching. All the eggs hatched. Then Rahima started rearing these ducklings. Start from there.

item.title: Central Bank advises Citigroup not to default
item.description: Bangladesh Bank has advised lending banks not to register the loans of the country's leading industrial conglomerate City Group as non-performing loans.

item.title: To emerge as a producer and exporter of technology
item.description: Jonaid Saki, Minister of State for Planning, said, 'It is important to create an effective link between business and government with innovation and research. An integrated platform involving government, business and academia is needed.

item.title: IDLC's SME Utsav Loan: Tk 35 lakh available without collateral
item.description: A large part of the country's Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) businesses depend on certain seasons of the year. Clothing is especially dependent on the season as a product.

item.title: Anup bought a computer with tuition money and is now a successful freelancer and entrepreneur
item.description: Anup Kumar Roy, a young man from Shariatpur, who grew up in a family of poverty, dreamed of becoming successful since childhood. And so the urge to stand by the family along with studies made him a hard worker at an early age.

item.title: How Sabbir went viral by making a web app with AI
item.description: Which of the 64 districts of Bangladesh have you visited, it can be seen on the map with one click. You can also download that map with your name.
